mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a comfortable 76 degrees, feeling like 81, near the Verona Public Library under a first quarter moon.

The City of Verona has introduced a new rain barrel rebate program where residents can earn a 30 dollar credit per barrel. Additionally, the city has updated sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover maintenance costs and prevent potential flooding or system failures.

There is a lot happening today, including the Epic Systems User Group Meeting, yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call from Friday, officers arrested a driver for an O W I after she was found unresponsive behind the wheel near North Main Street.
Today's flavor is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch. Culver's is open until 10 PM, so you still have plenty of time to grab a scoop before they close for the night.
